_scope_note: The request-tail policy (docs/REQUEST-TAIL-CONTRACT.md, PR #274): both 400s live in one shared block in chat.js (_handleChatCompletionsInner), and the Anthropic/Gemini converters drop turns that yield no text/image/tool BEFORE delegating there. Each mutation below removes one half of that contract; the pinned tests must red. Chat-surface assertions drive the REAL handleChatCompletions (a mock would bypass the guard); the converter assertions drive the real converters with a recording chat handler, because what they pin is what the converter forwards (drop → served, kept-with-text → the shared 400 re-enveloped).

mutations.name: predicate A disabled — an unanswerable tail (assistant-terminated, the Anthropic prefill shape) sails through to backend/account selection instead of the measured 400: the upstream answers UPSTREAM_INTERNAL and two consecutive of those quarantine the account for 120s

predicate B disabled — an empty newest user turn is forwarded: 79cd990 (fix #28, OpenClaw probe scenario #14) measured that the model then answers against the system prompt as if it were the prompt, and the class check exists because the upstream rejects such requests as UPSTREAM_INTERNAL

non-text parts stop counting as content — an image-only (or file/audio-only) user turn is reclassified as empty and rejected by predicate B, breaking every media-carrying turn 79cd990 deliberately kept legal ('pure-text empties only')
mutations.anchor: if (p && typeof p === 'object' && p.type && p.type !== 'text') return n + 1;

mutations.name: the Anthropic converter stops dropping turns that yield no text/image/tool — a textless turn becomes an empty-content message, so the shared guard now sees an assistant-terminated conversation (or an empty user turn) that the documented difference says is served, and the surface's answer flips from 200 to 400

the Gemini converter stops dropping turns that yield no text/image/tool — same flip as the Anthropic side: textless user/model turns materialise as empty-content messages and the request that was served becomes a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT
